Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Finexus is eager to move to a technical deep-dive so we can map Redwood's controls to our SOC 2 evidence matrix. Two immediate asks from our side:

- Walkthrough of where audit logs are stored and the retention/exports.
- Confirmation of encryption at rest keyflow and KMS integration (we use AWS KMS/HSM).

We'd like to kick off a 60-minute technical session next week focused on the runbook (we'll share our control mapping). Are you available any morning PT next week? If possible, include anyone who owns SSO/KMS on your side.

Attaching a short spreadsheet of the control buckets we want covered.

Quick availability: Tue/Wed next week (Oct 5/6) mornings PT look good for our infra folks. I'd like to include Marissa (security architect) and Vivek (product infra lead) so they can cover audit/export mechanics and KMS flow. Monica from CS will join to capture action items for evidence handoff.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) 10 min - intros & outcome alignment
2) 20 min - audit logs: collection, retention, export, and live demo of an export
3) 15 min - encryption & KMS integration (key rotation + customer-managed keys)
4) 10 min - SSO/SAML artifact mapping + evidence locations
5) 5 min - next steps and owner assignments

I'm attaching our controls runbook draft and a schematic for the log export flow. If that looks good, suggest Tue Oct 5 10:00 AM PT. If you need earlier, we can try 8:30 AM PT.

Karthik — forwarding a couple of quick notes so we're aligned before the call.

On Mon, Sep 28, 2026 at 10:02 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Sara — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to run the session.
> 
> Proposed agenda (60 min): ...

Notes for the demo (internal):
- Logs: plan to show index -> export flow. Have a redacted sample export ready (syslog format + JSON meta).
- Retention: default 90 days in hosted; Dedicated/Private customers can configure up to 2 years. Be ready to call out tier differences.
- KMS: demo customer-managed CMK flow (bring up key policy snippet). Confirm we can show key rotation timeline and where the key IDs appear in audit logs.
- SSO: prepare SAML assertion examples and the artifact location in the audit log for a successful login.

Action items before Tue
- Vivek: produce a redacted export sample and a short slide on retention tiers. (ETA Tue 9/29 EOD)
- Monica: assemble a short evidence checklist mapping Finexus buckets to our runbook sections. (ETA Mon 9/28 5pm PT)
- Marissa: pull KMS key policy example and redaction guide.

I'll join the meeting if it helps to cover the log export nuances. If Sara prefers a different date/time, we'll accommodate.

Marissa
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
